stat.running: How many scripts run right now, out of every script the server has.
stat.stopped: Scripts that exist but are stopped: their features do not work for players until you start them.
stat.protected: Core scripts that cannot be stopped from here, because the panel or the whole server depends on them.

resources.search: Filters the list by script name, state or description. Example: type hud to find w_hud.

filter.stopped: Only stopped or missing scripts: their features are gone for players.
filter.protected: The protected scripts that cannot be stopped from the panel.

group.ours: Red River scripts (their names start with w_): the server's main features. Stopping or restarting one asks you to type its name to confirm.
group.others: Scripts from outside Red River, such as tools and databases. Same buttons, with a normal confirmation.
group.protected: Scripts whose stop would take the panel or the whole server down, so they cannot be stopped here. Restart the server from txAdmin instead.

col.name: The script's name as it is in the server files, with its description under it when its author wrote one.
col.version: The script's version number. Useful to check that a new update really arrived.
col.state: Whether the script runs now: Running, Stopped or Starting, and Missing when its files were not found on the server.
col.actions: Start, stop or restart the script. Point at a button to see exactly what it does.

start.text: Starts the script, so its features come back for players within seconds. Nobody online is affected.
start.undo: Yes, stop it again with Stop

restart.text: Stops the script and starts it again. Players may notice its feature pause for a few seconds. Useful after editing its files.
restart.undo: Nothing to undo: the script comes back by itself

stop.text: Stops the script now, so its feature disappears for every player until you start it. Example: stopping w_hud hides the hunger and thirst bars.
stop.undo: Yes, with Start on the same line

resources.protected: This script is protected: nobody can stop or restart it from the panel, because the panel or the server depends on it.

confirmCore.text: This is a core Red River script: stopping it affects every player at once, and other scripts may depend on it. Type its exact name so we know you mean it.

resources.search: Search by script name or state…

lead.ours: The server's main features. Stop and restart ask you to type the script name.
lead.others: Tools and scripts from outside Red River.
lead.protected: The panel or the server depends on them, so they are not stopped or restarted here.

resources.stopText: The feature of "%s" stops for every player until you start it again.
resources.restartText: "%s" stops and starts again, so its feature pauses for a few seconds for every player.
resources.coreNote: This is a core Red River script; other scripts that depend on it may be affected.
resources.none: No scripts match this search or filter.
resources.waiting: Waiting for the script list from the server…
